This comparison examines the characteristics of adult patients with [[ibd|IBD]] who had a hospital contact between October 1, 2024, and September 30, 2025, contrasting those who are newly diagnosed with the broader prevalent patient population [^src1]. In total, there were 2,475 newly diagnosed patients compared to 31,951 other patients with a hospital contact during the period [^src1].

Regarding diagnoses, [[colitis-ulcerosa|Colitis ulcerosa]] is the leading condition in both cohorts, accounting for 60% (1,477) of newly diagnosed patients and 56% (17,982) of the prevalent group [^src1]. [[crohns-sygdom|Crohns sygdom]] follows as the second most common, representing 39% (954) of new cases and 43% (13,611) of prevalent cases [^src1]. [[psc|Primær skleroserende kolangitis (PSC)]] and [[korttarmssyndrom|korttarmssyndrom]] are the least common, each comprising 1% or less of both groups [^src1].

Demographically, the newly diagnosed cohort is notably younger, with a median age of 38 years (mean 43), whereas the prevalent population has a median and mean age of 49 years [^src1]. The largest age group among newly diagnosed patients is 18-29 years (30%), while the prevalent group peaks in the 30-39 years bracket (20%) [^src1]. Gender distribution also presents an outlier pattern: newly diagnosed patients are slightly majority male (51% men, 49% women), whereas the prevalent population skews female (54% women, 46% men) [^src1].

In terms of healthcare utilization, both groups exhibit identical contact frequencies, averaging 11 contacts (median 9) per patient [^src1]. Physical contacts lead over virtual ones in both groups, comprising 67% of contacts for newly diagnosed patients and 64% for the prevalent group [^src1]. Because this data represents a single reporting period, no longitudinal trends can be established.

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner karakteristika for nydiagnosticerede og prævalente voksne med IBD, og viser at colitis ulcerosa dominerer blandt nydiagnosticerede, mens køn er næsten ligeligt fordelt og alderen er højere blandt prævalente, samt at fysisk kontakt udgør størstedelen af kontakterne.
